name: HOGAN, the Hon. Kevin John

headline.note: Finance, teaching, investment, consultancy and farm work remain incompletely dated. State Bank ownership changed on 31 December 1994, preventing a wholly private classification of the combined finance spell. CSRF four-day work near departure is evidenced, but exact hours/FTE and earlier arrangements are unknown. Governance, study and elected office are excluded; no zero inferred from missing evidence.

career_spells.evidence_note: Hogan's current biography identifies an economics degree; secondary material identifies Flinders University and completion in 1984. Start date, study load and employment overlap are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Study is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.employer: State Bank of NSW and Colonial State Bank (official wording; entity sequence unresolved)
career_spells.evidence_note: The frozen official extract gives these employers, role and year boundaries. Current and secondary biographies describe Sydney finance work, a multi-billion-dollar portfolio and variants including GIO Securities and Colonial First State. Exact employer transitions, ownership/control at each date, appointment dates, hours and leave are unresolved; the entity variants are not silently collapsed into a precise chronology. RBA 1995 annual report dates State Bank privatisation to 31 December 1994. Therefore the combined 1989–1998 spell cannot be treated as wholly private. Government control remains mixed across the named sequence; individual employer transitions must be resolved before splitting public-corporation and private-enterprise periods.
career_spells.counting_note: Finance employment is supported, but government control changed or is disputed across the named entities, and full-time status and exact boundaries are unproved.

career_spells.evidence_note: Secondary material identifies the qualification and 1998 completion; a published interview says Hogan completed a Diploma of Education before teaching. Enrolment dates, load and overlap with finance work are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Study is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.role: Business Studies and Commerce teacher; Deputy Principal for an unresolved period
career_spells.evidence_note: The frozen official extract supplies the school and year boundaries. Hogan's and the Nationals' biographies identify teaching Business Studies and a period as Deputy Principal; an interview also identifies economics teaching. Exact appointment, leadership and departure dates, employing Catholic-school entity, hours and leave are unresolved. ABC2013 says seven years teaching; a22April2022 first-person candidate profile says ten years. Preserve the official1999–2006 boundaries and record this duration conflict rather than back-calculating different dates.
career_spells.counting_note: Private/non-government school employment is supported, but substantive full-time status and exact dates are not established.

career_spells.role: Teacher, second appointment; subjects and leadership duty unresolved
career_spells.evidence_note: The2017 Parliamentary Handbook explicitly lists a second teaching interval2011–12, separate from1999–2006. Retain year precision; exact dates, payroll entity, hours, leave and any Deputy Principal duties in this return are unknown. A separate spell prevents counting the intervening gap as continuous teaching.
career_spells.counting_note: Full-time status is unproven; no headline duration calculated. Do not resolve seven-versus-ten-year rounded claims by imposing exact calendar years.

career_spells.employer: Catholic Superannuation and Retirement Fund (CSRF Industry Superannuation Fund)
career_spells.evidence_note: Frozen record supplies Investment Officer 2006–2008. Contemporary 16 September 2008 Investment Magazine report says Hogan worked four days weekly; the fund CEO says expanded duties required full-time availability and that Hogan had resigned a few weeks earlier. Part-time status is supported at the end of this appointment, not inferred from title; arrangements earlier in the spell require verification. Exact cessation month/day, daily hours and contractual FTE remain unknown. Board service is now separated.
career_spells.counting_note: Four days weekly does not establish 0.8 FTE without contracted hours and a normal full-time comparator. No substantive full-time interval established; no headline years calculated.

career_spells.evidence_note: Current political biographies say Hogan operated a small business; secondary material calls it a consultancy after his superannuation work. Legal name, services, commencement, cessation, remuneration, hours and overlap with farming and campaigning are unresolved. The 2013 election is only an outer boundary, not proof of exact cessation. Follow-up removes the former 2013 election-based end field: no source establishes business cessation at election. ABC2013 candidate profile specifies superannuation consultancy, resolving the business activity but not its legal name or exact operating interval.
career_spells.counting_note: Private self-employment is supported, but no countable full-time interval is established.

career_spells.employer: Hogan family cattle property near Lismore
career_spells.evidence_note: Biographies say Hogan runs or ran his own farm/cattle property near Lismore; an interview places the property purchase on the move to the region in 1998. Ownership, business entity, active-work dates, hours, income, leave and continuation after election are unresolved; property ownership alone is not treated as continuous full-time work.
career_spells.counting_note: Private farming activity is supported, but hours and active-work boundaries are insufficient for calculation.

career_spells.evidence_note: A published interview records joining the Nationals in 2009; secondary material records candidacy in 2010 and 2013. Membership, candidate remuneration, hours and overlaps with business/farm work are unresolved and party activity is not assumed to be employment.
career_spells.counting_note: Party activity is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.evidence_note: The frozen roster and biographies establish House service from the 7 September 2013 election. Parliamentary, ministerial, shadow and party-room offices are nested within elected service.
career_spells.counting_note: Elected office is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.evidence_note: 2016 interview describes board membership through teaching connections before taking responsibility for investments. No board appointment or cessation dates, director fees or hours are supplied. Separated from the 2006–2008 paid investment role to avoid treating governance as executive employment.
career_spells.counting_note: Governance role excluded from full-time public/private employment headlines.

career_spells.role: Independent non-executive committee member representing Catholic Super
career_spells.evidence_note: Company annual report 2007–2008 identifies Hogan and records one attended/one eligible meeting. Later trade report places IAB formation in mid-2008. Individual appointment and resignation dates remain unknown; report coverage is not copied into an employment interval. Trinity2009 annual report independently supplies personal resignation24September2008 and successor Greg Cantor appointment the same day. The board end date is now exact; it is not the CSRF employee cessation date.
career_spells.counting_note: Investor advisory/governance role excluded; not additional paid Trinity employment or duplicated CSRF duration.

career_spells.employer: Lismore City Council — Clunes Wastewater Committee
career_spells.evidence_note: Council minutes resolution246/04 appoint Kevin Hogan among community representatives. Identity supported by matching local wastewater advisory service in his party biography. Cessation, meeting schedule and remuneration unknown; committee membership is governance, not a council employee appointment. Council resolution252/08 on9December2008 retired the committee (minutes reproduced in10February2009 business papers). This is an outer bound for the original committee, not proof Hogan personally remained a member until dissolution; individual cessation stays unknown.
career_spells.counting_note: Community advisory/governance service excluded from employment headline; no salaried full-time work inferred.

career_spells.employer: Local state primary-school Parents and Citizens association and local sports club (names unresolved)
career_spells.role: P&C vice-president; sports-club president and junior-team coach
career_spells.evidence_note: Primary party biography lists these community roles. Names, separate terms, remuneration and hours not stated; no full-time paid status inferred. Multiple undated activities retained together pending organisation/term identification.
career_spells.counting_note: Excluded category; not added to public/private employment headlines.

career_spells.evidence_note: Public transcription of the45th Parliament interests register records Hogan as honorary director on15March2018. This is a dated observation, not an appointment boundary. The honorary description supports governance rather than paid operational employment; exact term, duties and hours remain unknown.
career_spells.counting_note: Honorary nonprofit governance is excluded; no substantive paid employment established.

research_notes: Employer names in official and narrative biographies conflict for the 1989–1998 finance career; the record preserves that ambiguity rather than assigning years to unsupported entities.
The St Mary's role, omitted from the frozen occupation title, is identified as teaching and temporary Deputy Principal work by Hogan's current biography.
CSRF governance and paid investment work are not assumed to have identical dates or hours.
Farm ownership is not converted to continuous employment, and no post-election cessation is invented for business or farm activity.

Follow-up 2026-10-01: direct contemporary CEO account resolves four-day CSRF work and departure before 16 September 2008. No back-calculated departure day or automatic 0.8 FTE. Political-blog claims of a September resignation are not substituted for the contemporary report stating departure a few weeks earlier.

ASX-hosted Trinity report supplies primary non-executive advisory membership and meeting attendance. Separated both CSRF board service and Trinity IAB from paid investment work; no adverse-performance claims imported from partisan commentary.

RBA primary ownership evidence corrects the combined State Bank/Colonial spell from private to unresolved sector allocation. Retain original employer variants; do not assign GIO, Colonial First State and Colonial State Bank identical periods. GIO remains an early-employer lead needing appointment dates and control at the actual time.

Attempted targeted annual-report, investment-industry, school/university and early-employer searches. Exact teacher/Deputy Principal hours and dates, earliest finance sequence, consultancy entity and farming labour remain unresolved. Next use historic CSRF trustee reports, school staff records and employer-specific appointments.

Second follow-up2October2026 adds omitted local wastewater governance and school/sport community roles. Council minutes anchor Clunes appointment to14December2004, rather than the8February2005 date of the containing business papers. Roles are excluded from paid-employment totals.

Targeted CSRF appointment, school leadership and consultancy/legal-entity searches did not resolve personal hours or finance employer transitions.2026 industry profiles repeat employer variants without dates; reader comments are not used as evidence. US management consultant Kevin Hogan and UK delivery director are namesakes, not this member. New priority: Clunes committee cessation minutes and named school/sport records, alongside still-open CSRF terms, finance transitions and consultancy entity.

Follow-up3October2026 retrieved the actual Clunes retirement resolution, distinct from the9December2008 agenda recommendation. It establishes committee dissolution only, not personal cessation. Added specific superannuation consultancy activity and recorded seven-versus-ten-year teaching conflict. Targeted P&C and club searches led to a partisan reproduction of an apparent2010 campaign page; original NLA/Pandora page reader returned Internal Error (no code), so the Clunes P&C/tennis vice-presidency wording remains an unverified lead. No primary school/club term or employment hours obtained. Declared-interest summaries suggest honorary Page Research Institute directorship; verify the original parliamentary register before adopting.

Fourth follow-up4October2026 located a public45th Parliament interests transcription recording Hogan as honorary director of Page Research Institute on15March2018. Added this as excluded nonprofit governance, not employment; appointment/cessation, duties and hours remain unknown. The same search surfaced secondary reproductions of his2010 campaign biography naming Clunes P&C and tennis offices, but the original archived page remained unavailable and the reproductions do not resolve term dates or payment. No finance, teaching, consultancy or farm hours inferred.

Follow-up2026-10-04: Recovered full historic official handbook supplies omitted2011–12 teaching return; separate spell added without bridging2006–2011 gap. Original2009 Trinity employer report gives exact24September2008 advisory resignation, distinct from CSRF paid-work departure before16September. Member-hosted maiden speech mentions periodic Sky News economic updates but compensation, formal employer, dates and hours remain an unverified employment lead; no paid media spell inferred. Web-reader403s recovered through ordinary public PDF retrieval; no access-control bypass. Finance entity sequence and full-time teacher evidence remain unresolved.
open_questions: Which finance legal entities employed Hogan from 1989 to 1998, on what exact dates and under what government control at each transition?
Were the finance roles full-time, and what leave or breaks occurred?
What were the exact St Mary's appointment, Deputy Principal and departure dates, payroll entity, hours and leave?
What were the separate CSRF board and Investment Officer dates, remuneration, hours and employment status?
What was the consultancy/small-business legal entity, service, dates, income and weekly hours?
What active farm work and hours occurred before and after election, separately from property ownership?
Were the 2010 and 2013 federal candidacies remunerated or accompanied by other paid work?
How were the State Bank years divided around the 31 December 1994 privatisation, and did employer changes differ from the corporate transaction?
What was the exact CSRF cessation day before 16 September 2008, and did the four-day arrangement cover the entire 2006–2008 appointment?
What were the CSRF board and Trinity IAB appointment/cessation dates and fees?
When did Clunes Wastewater Committee service cease; which school P&C and sports club, on what dates and with what remuneration or volunteer basis?

Did Hogan leave the Clunes committee before its9December2008 dissolution; how can the seven-versus-ten-year teaching accounts be reconciled? Verify original2010 biography for Clunes P&C/tennis offices and original appointment/cessation records for Page Research Institute governance.
What were the2011–2012 return-to-teaching appointment dates, hours, payroll entity and overlaps with consultancy/farming; did Deputy Principal duties belong to this interval or the earlier one?
